name: fidy-ai-crap-tools
description: Isolated classic-TypeScript install for crap4ts. crap4ts parses source through @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree, which needs the classic `typescript` compiler API; the root package pins the Effect tsgo `typescript` build, which does not expose it. Keeping crap4ts and a classic typescript here lets the analyzer run without disturbing the root toolchain. The pin tracks the classic 6.x line and stops there on purpose: typescript@7 ships no compiler API at all — its main entry resolves to a version stub — and typescript-estree's peer range ends below 6.1. Revisit when TypeScript 7.1 ships the replacement API and typescript-estree adopts it.
